title: Conflicts in Texts: Data, Implications and Challenges
findings: As a survey paper not focused on religion, it presents no specific findings on this topic. It cites one paper (Naous et al., 2024) that measures cultural bias using a religiously-contextualized example ('beer after prayer'), but does not elaborate on religious findings itself.
